A1.justification: Both PDFs describe DA2 and contain corresponding main sections, Figures 1–9, Tables 1–5 and Appendices A–F. Text extraction and rendered-page inspection support a reliable comparison, including changes embedded in figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original DA2 benchmark results, training-data and component ablations, and qualitative reconstruction examples in Tables 1–3 and Figures 5–9.

after.justification: v4 retains the original DA2 evaluations, ablations and application demonstrations, and reports revised inference times in Figure 5.

M1.justification: The panoramic data curation pipeline, FLUX-I2P outpainting, SphereViT architecture, spherical cross-attention and distance/normal losses remain unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix E.

E1.justification: Both use the same seven training datasets and evaluate on Stanford2D3D-S, Matterport3D and PanoSUNCG. Appendix A retains the same multi-view reconstruction, home-renovation and robotics applications.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same in-domain and zero-shot comparator rows. Figure 5 still compares DA2 with UniK3D and MoGev2, and Appendix F's baseline descriptions are unchanged. The related-work citation changes do not alter evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: The stated splits, alignment procedures, metrics, training budgets and model configurations are unchanged. Appendix E newly specifies the timing-test resolution, but neither version establishes a change from the earlier testing procedure; this is additional documentation.

E4.justification: The data-scaling and component ablations in Tables 2–3 and Figures 2 and 6 are retained. The failure examples in Figure 7 and application case studies in Appendix A also remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, experimental seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. Reporting scalar results and averaging across evaluation datasets remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Figure 5 changes the reported inference times for both DA2 and UniK3D from approximately 0.3 s to 0.1 s; MoGev2 remains approximately 28 s. Accuracy results in Tables 1–3 and qualitative examples are unchanged. Because v1 does not specify timing resolution, these revisions do not establish a same-setting speedup.

T1.justification: Equations 1–12, the projection and spherical-embedding derivations, and the depth-category definitions in Appendix D and Table 5 are unchanged. No formal assumptions, theorems or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: Both retain the same contributions: panoramic data scaling, SphereViT, comprehensive benchmarking and efficient zero-shot depth estimation. The claimed average 38% AbsRel improvement and claims of outperforming prior in-domain methods remain unchanged.

C2.justification: The explanations of data scaling, outpainting, spherical embedding and normal supervision are retained. Section 5 preserves the same limitations concerning missing fine details and panorama-boundary seams, attributed to resolution and partial depth supervision.

D1.justification: The abstract changes code and curated-data availability from a promised future release to a reported completed release. Appendix E adds that Figure 5 timings use 1024×512 resolution; the H20 hardware and exclusion of I/O were already stated. Other implementation details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2.1 and the bibliography add Gu et al. (2024), DOME, and remove Li et al. (2025a), StereoDiff. The broader positioning against perspective and panoramic depth methods is retained. Abbreviating Black Forest Labs to BFL does not introduce another work.

P1.justification: Local edits affect the release-status sentence, citation formatting and acknowledgments. Section 6 removes the Yijing Guo/PanoSUNCG acknowledgment and adds Luigi Piccinelli. The main narrative, section order and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 2 reverses the accuracy-gain arrow from downward to upward, with small plot-sizing and spacing adjustments. Figure 5 retains its qualitative panels with revised timing labels. All tables and appendix figures retain their structure.

improvement.justification: Specifying the timing resolution in Appendix E and correcting Figure 2's misleading accuracy-gain arrow modestly improve reproducibility reporting and visual clarity. v4 also reports completed code/data release, although availability cannot be verified from the PDFs. Scientific validation remains unchanged, and the unexplained runtime revisions do not establish a same-setting performance improvement.
